explanations.23: useBlogPost() is a hook from Docusaurus that tells you whether you're viewing a full blog post page or just seeing a preview card in a list.
explanations.24: This returns a CSS class name only when we're in list view (not on the full post page), or undefined if we're on the actual post page.
explanations.31: This checks two things: whether the post is marked as AI-assisted in its metadata, AND whether we're viewing the full post page (not a card); it only renders the AIIcon component if both are true.
explanations.57: This checks if tried_it is explicitly set to false in the post's settings; if it's not false (meaning it's true or missing), the TriedIt component will render.
